_doc: F5 composition: diagnose why the slow-consumer queue is backed up. Originally required BOTH get-queue-metrics and get-client-details, but the F5 fixture is queue-level (slowSubscriber flag does NOT flip — see SOL-150328) and get-queue-metrics alone exposes the full diagnosis (bindCount=1, txUnackedMsgCount at maxDeliveredUnackedMsgsPerFlow ceiling, rxMsgRate > txMsgRate, growing spool). A 'complete with one tool' answer is correct here, so any_of replaces all_of. required_substrings_any_of targets diagnostic terminology (unacked / ceiling / spool) rather than 'slow' — the queue name itself contains 'slow', so a substring match on 'slow' would PASS on a refusal that just echoes the queue name. forbidden_substrings catches refusals from missing fixtures.
prompt: Why is queue $F5_QUEUE backed up on $BROKER? Give a concrete diagnosis grounded in current broker state.
